author: GNiendorf
body:
#### PR description:

`Phase2TrackerRecHits` makes the Phase-2 Outer Tracker rechits, offline (`siPhase2RecHits`) and in the Phase-2 HLT (`hltSiPhase2RecHits`). It filled its output hit by hit, growing it through repeated reallocations, and then copied it once more in `shrink_to_fit`. jemalloc returns the pages of allocations of 8 MiB or more to the OS as soon as they are freed, so these buffers are written to fresh pages every event: with 16 jobs per machine the module takes ~280 ms/event in the HLT CPU menu, while it is 0.16% of the CPU time in a single-thread profile.

Every cluster gives exactly one rechit, so the output is now reserved to its final size before the cluster loop, the hits are emplaced, and `shrink_to_fit` is removed. The output is unchanged.

#### PR validation:

- HLT (`75e33_timing` CPU menu), 100 ttbar + 100 QCD PU200 events: 116 tracking products bitwise identical. MTV: [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/phase2-rechits-reserve/hlt_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/phase2-rechits-reserve/hlt_qcd/plots_hlt.html)
- Offline (workflow 34634.1, trackingOnly), same events: 187 tracking products (rechits, seeds, candidates and tracks of every iteration, vertices) bitwise identical. MTV: [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/phase2-rechits-reserve/off_ttbar/index.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/internal-prs/phase2-rechits-reserve/off_qcd/index.html)
- HLT timing, CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300 vs the same IB + this PR, on an AMD EPYC 9654 (96 cores, 192 threads) with an NVIDIA L40 for the GPU menu; 16 jobs x 16 threads x 16 streams, 300 ttbar PU200 events per job, mean of 3 rounds, ms/event:

| | CPU menu | GPU menu |
|---|---|---|
| hltSiPhase2RecHits | 282 -> 79 | 229 -> 58 |
| Tracking | 1543 -> 1331 | 881 -> 706 |
| whole menu | 10622 -> 10220 | 6317 -> 5906 |
| throughput | +4.1% | +7.0% |

**One important thing to note: the saving grows with machine load, since the time removed is page faults on freshly allocated memory. With only a few jobs per machine, the gain can be negligible.**

- Host memory: single-job peak RSS unchanged within the round-to-round spread; 16 jobs of the GPU menu +2% (149 -> 152 GiB). GPU memory is not affected (host-only module).
title: Phase2TrackerRecHits: allocate the output once
